json_document_profile.canonical_rule: RFC-8259-compatible JSON, sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, UTF-8, then one LF.

expression_language.$record: construct the named record recursively from its exact catalogue row
expression_language.$enum: resolve the exact named enum member
expression_language.$variant: apply the named exact /variant_catalogue program before baseline correlation and construction
expression_language.$enclosing_copy: during structural-variant closure only, deep-copy the exact RFC-6901 path from the enclosing normalized call after the referenced sibling baseline field is correlated; fail if absent
expression_language.$baseline_copy: deep-copy the value at the exact RFC-6901 path from the immutable fully correlated baseline snapshot; fail if absent
expression_language.$current_copy: deep-copy the value at the exact RFC-6901 path from the current normalized call; fail if absent
expression_language.$support: recursively materialize the exact named /materialization_contract/closed_variant_support_catalogue entry; fail on recursion or an unknown name
expression_language.$support_copy: materialize the exact named support, then deep-copy its exact RFC-6901 path; fail if the support or path is absent
expression_language.arrays: materialize as exact tuple when the owning annotation is tuple; otherwise exact list is forbidden

baseline_correlation_rules: Expand every atom and record into the normalized constructor/positional/kwargs form, apply /variant_catalogue programs, then compute all baseline correlations before saving the immutable baseline snapshot.
After all non-digest fields exist, compute every digest wrapper through its exact owning I-5 hashing callable; catalogue digest literals are only deterministic seeds where no derived object exists.
EventDeclaration predecessor is NOT_APPLICABLE for the sole baseline row; phase-1 PhaseCommitRecord predecessor is NOT_APPLICABLE.

TraceRowFrame materializer_source is excluded from constructor arguments; project that exact CanonicalTraceRow, set row_digest through the accepted canonical-trace-row hash callable, then set frame_bytes to u64be(len(row_bytes)) plus row_bytes.
CanonicalTracePrefix row_count equals materialized frame count and prefix_digest is recomputed from literal frames.

PhysicalPhaseTransaction trace_row_digest equals its PhaseCommitRecord trace_row_digest; AtomicStoreRequest expected_trace_prefix is the deterministic TraceDigest catalogue seed unless a declared operation replaces it.

DurablePrefixEvidence request_ref and committed_prefix equal the request values; when the request contains a physical transaction, phase_commit_digest is the exact digest of that PhaseCommitRecord; evidence_digest is then recomputed excluding itself.
CompleteTraceEvidence trace_digest and last_prefix_digest equal the exact correlated prefix digest and confirmed_row_count equals its row_count.

Every named structural variant has one exact deterministic program in /variant_catalogue and every apply_closed_variant coordinate has one expansion in /closed_variant_catalogue; no test chooses values at run time.

closed_variant_operator.coordinate_key: The exact ordered pair (vector.materialization.baseline_call, patch.value); neither component may be normalized, inferred, or replaced by the expected outcome.
closed_variant_operator.normalized_call: Deep-copy and recursively expand the selected /call_catalogue row to objects containing only interface, positional, kwargs, constructor, materializer_source, and exact values. JSON arrays remain addressable during normalization and are deterministically constructed as exact tuples wherever the owning annotation is tuple; no runtime list is permitted there. Correlate the baseline, then preserve an immutable baseline snapshot.
closed_variant_operator.lookup: For each apply_closed_variant patch in stored vector order, require exactly one nested /closed_variant_catalogue[baseline_call][failure-code operand] row. Zero or multiple matches fail closed.
closed_variant_operator.support_order: support_records is the complete dependency inventory. A string equal to a /closed_variant_support_catalogue key is recursively constructed before the first operation; an atom, enum, typed digest, applicability, or exact bytes label must occur as the exact value expression of an operation and is constructed while that operation resolves. Reject support cycles, unknown $support names, failed paths, failed enum/digest/record construction, inventory/value disagreement, or unused supports.
closed_variant_operator.operation_order: Execute operations in stored order. replace requires its exact path to exist; append_current_copy requires both list_path and source_path to exist; append_support and prepend_support require the named support; replace_tuple requires the target tuple path; replace_by_constructor requires the target path and exactly one exact constructor-name case; relink_event_predecessor_chain walks the exact tuple from index 1 upward and replaces each declared target_relative path with a deep copy of the immediately previous row's source_relative path. No other operation is legal.
closed_variant_operator.recompute_order: After operations, execute only the listed recompute rows in ascending consecutive order, require every dependency path to exist, and reject an affected derived field that lacks a declared recomputation. No implicit post-variant baseline correlation is permitted.
closed_variant_operator.multiple_patch_rule: Apply coordinate expansions sequentially in vector patch order to the same current call. Every operation must preserve predicates already activated unless the exact vector would then fail joint reachability; such a vector is inadmissible and materialization stops.
closed_variant_operator.joint_reachability_rule: A MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_PRECEDENCE vector is admissible only when a closed, deterministic effective input proves that every listed active predicate is simultaneously true. Ordering in failure_precedence alone is not evidence of joint reachability.
closed_variant_operator.dynamic_invocation: After construction, invoke exactly vector.validation_owner once, capture its first FrameworkFailure or success value, and compare it with vector.expected. Static vectors invoke no framework interface.

vector_schema.non_static_rule: Every non-static vector names its exact owning future interface or constructor and a closed baseline plus deterministic patches; future tests must construct and invoke that interface, not assert metadata.

call_count_totals.rule: Exactly one owning constructor/interface invocation per dynamic vector; support constructors are not counted as owning calls.

predicate_activation_counts.rule: Count each listed true predicate once per vector.
